text: 兴福电子公告，公司拟以简易程序向特定对象发行A股股票，募集资金总额不超过人民币2.6亿元，发行对象不超过35名，募集资金扣除发行费用后拟用于4万吨/年电子级磷酸项目。本次发行相关事项已获公司2025年年度股东会授权及董事会审议通过，尚需上交所审核通过并经中国证监会同意注册。
text_en: Xingfu Electronic announced that the company plans to issue A-shares to specific targets through a simplified procedure, with total funds raised not exceeding RMB 260 million and no more than 35 issuance targets. After deducting issuance expenses, the raised funds are intended for a 40,000-ton-per-year electronic-grade phosphoric acid project. The relevant matters of this issuance have been authorized by the company's 2025 annual shareholders' meeting and approved by the board of directors, and still require approval by the SSE and registration consent from the CSRC.
